Here’s the raw deal—short answer up front:

**You can’t get the full *IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate* for free.**

That said, you *can*:

1. **Audit many of the courses for free** (meaning you have access to lessons, videos, and sometimes quizzes—but **no certificate**).
2. **Use IBM SkillsBuild** to access a range of generative AI and foundational AI courses **completely free**—and **earn verified digital credentials**, though not the full Professional Certificate.

---

###  What’s on Coursera – and what’s free?

- The **IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate** is offered via Coursera—a series of 16 courses that take around 6 months to complete at ~6 hours per week. You *can* “Enroll for free,” which grants **access to course content**, but:
  - You **must pay** (via subscription or Coursera Plus) to **receive the official certificate**. citeturn0search0
  - Sometimes Coursera offers a **7-day free trial**, but after that period, you’ll need to subscribe to continue and to get the certificate. citeturn0search13turn0search5
  - Some regional estimates (INR 3,698–11,095) refer to an *AI Engineering* certificate (a related but distinct program), but again—certificate delivery requires payment. citeturn0search2

---

### IBM’s Free Alternative – SkillsBuild

- **IBM SkillsBuild** is an entirely **free educational platform** offering self-paced courses in AI—including **Generative AI**, **Prompt Engineering**, **NLP**, **AI ethics**, and more.
- On completion of those learning modules, you **earn verified digital credentials** from IBM that you can share on LinkedIn or your resume. citeturn0search1turn0search24
- While not the same as the *Professional Certificate*, it’s a solid, zero-cost way to gain recognized credentials and build foundational skills in AI.

---

### Summary Table

| Pathway                                    | Cost           | Certificate?              | Notes                                            |
|--------------------------------------------|----------------|---------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| Coursera Professional Certificate (Gen AI) | Free to audit  |  **Paid subscription required** | Access content for free; certificate if paid.   |
| Coursera trial (7-day)                    | Free for 7 days| Only during trial         | After trial, subscription is required.           |
| IBM SkillsBuild platform                  |  Completely free |  Yes (digital credentials)    | Covers foundational and generative AI content.  |

---

### My Take—No sugar coating:

You're not getting the full, official **IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate** for free. But if you're looking to beef up your resume without spending a dime, **IBM SkillsBuild** is the smartest, most straightforward route. You’ll gain marketable skills and credentials, even if it’s not that specific certificate.

Want help navigating the SkillsBuild platform, mapping out which courses to take, or pairing it with other resources to simulate a full professional certificate pathway? I’ve got your back—just say the word.

Yeah, Coursera is sneaky about this now. They’ve been phasing out the **“Audit” button** on many of the *Professional Certificates* (especially the IBM ones), because they want you on subscription.  

Here’s the reality:  

- **Single courses** within that Professional Certificate (like *“Generative AI: Prompt Engineering Basics”* or *“Introduction to Generative AI”*) sometimes still have a hidden audit option.  
- But if you try to enroll directly via the **full Professional Certificate page**, Coursera will usually only show the **free trial → subscription** path.  

---

### Workarounds if you want free access:
1. **Enroll in each course separately**  
   - Go to the **course page** (not the certificate page).  
   - Scroll all the way down under the big blue "Enroll" button.  
   - Sometimes you’ll see **“Audit the course”** or **“Full course, no certificate”** in tiny gray text.  
   - Example: [Introduction to Generative AI](https://www.coursera.org/learn/introduction-to-generative-ai) (check bottom).  

2. **Use IBM SkillsBuild (free, no tricks)**  
   - IBM has literally copied a lot of the same modules from Coursera into **[SkillsBuild](https://skillsbuild.org/adult-learners/explore-learning/artificial-intelligence)**.  
   - 100% free, no time limits, you even get **IBM digital badges**.  
   - Only difference: Coursera’s “Professional Certificate” branding isn’t there.  

3. **Coursera financial aid**  
   - If you *really* want the official certificate, apply for **Coursera Financial Aid** (button under enroll).  
   - You write a short essay (“I’m a student, want to learn skills, can’t afford this right now”).  
   - They approve most applicants → you get the full course + certificate free (but it takes ~15 days for approval).  

---

👉 Straight talk: Coursera is locking down free audits for these “professional certificate bundles.” If your goal is *learning the content*, IBM **SkillsBuild** is the free and straightforward way. If your goal is *having the Coursera certificate with IBM’s name*, you’ll need **financial aid** or pay.
